dashboard.title: Monitoring dashboard
dashboard.browserOnly: Layout only is saved in this browser and shared by accounts using it. Monitoring data is not saved with the layout.
dashboard.notSaved: Layout changed for this visit. Browser storage is unavailable; changes will not be kept.
trend.perResource: Each line shows one resource at its actual observation times. The table identifies each resource; lines are not a fleet total.
insight.loaded: Ranked within the loaded observation set. Partial reads cannot prove a fleet-wide ranking.
